➡️ Hong Kong man loses HK$13 million in fake crypto investment app scam 

🌐 A Hong Kong man in his 70s has lost more than HK$13 million ($1.67 million) after a self-described cryptocurrency investment expert contacted him through WhatsApp and directed him to a fake trading app. The latest case began when the elderly man received an unsolicited WhatsApp message from someone claiming to be a cryptocurrency investment expert from Singapore. The person introduced him to what was presented as a crypto platform offering favorable exchange rates, low fees and withdrawals at any time.

‼️ Following the instructions he received, the man opened a cryptocurrency wallet and purchased Tether (USDT) and Ethereum (ETH). He was then told to download an investment application supplied by the scammer and transfer the cryptocurrency to designated wallet addresses as investment capital.

📣 Seeing his account balance rise inside the app, the victim became less suspicious and continued sending more cryptocurrency to the wallets provided by the scammer. The fraud only became clear when he tried to withdraw his funds and was repeatedly prevented from doing so under different pretexts. By the time the victim realized the investment platform was fraudulent, his losses had exceeded HK$13 million.

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council Major General Mohsen Rezaei says that the Iranian Armed Forces are more prepared than before if the US intends to attack the Islamic Republic.

“Iran is ready for a fateful war; we are aware of the weaknesses of the US military and are more prepared than ever to confront them,” General Rezaei said in an interview with al-Jazeera TV on Saturday.
​
Rezaei said that Iran changed its strategy toward the US after Washington withdrew from a memorandum of understanding that was signed in June and sought to permanently end the aggression.
​
He said Iran has recently tested an anti-ship missile near a US aircraft carrier, adding that the country will target all US bases and interests in the region if it is attacked again.
​
Iran’s top security official said that Iran has conveyed its conditions for ending the war to the US through Qatar, adding that Tehran is continuing its consultations with Qatari and Pakistani mediators.
​
“We are waiting for Trump's response to these conditions. Ending the war on all fronts, the release of our blocked assets, and the end of the naval blockade,” he said.
​
Rezaei also said that Iran seeks an end to the ongoing war between Saudi Arabia and Yemen, adding that he believes the Yemeni armed forces also seek an agreement with Saudi Arabia.
